conversation.message: Hello! Welcome to Bitso. I'm thrilled to have you here. Before we dive into the details, may I have your full name, please?
My name is Michael Soprano, im 33 from Houston. I am interested in the legal assistant position with 3 years of experience doing law.
Great to meet you, Michael! The legal assistant position sounds like a fantastic fit for you. Before we proceed, may I ask how you heard about the job opening at Bitso?
I heard through the ad you ran on facebook.

That's wonderful to hear, Michael. Thank you for sharing that. Now, let's schedule your interview. Could you please let me know your availability for the interview in the upcoming week? And also, what is your preferred method of contact?
Next weekend works, and contact me at mikey123@gmail.com

Fantastic, Michael! Next weekend it is. I will reach out to you via email at mikey123@gmail.com to confirm the details. Great, thank you so much for your time, Michael. We will take a look and reach out; If you have any other questions about a position or the company, please let me know. Otherwise, have a great day!
